title: Deputies responding code 3 lights and sirens to shooting in Cloquet, MN
description:
While attending a funeral, a man shot his sister's boyfriend in the back of the head using a rifle. The victim survived, identified the shooter and made a full recovery. The shooter has since pleaded guilty to related charges. 

More details here: https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/news/crime-and-courts/6683878-Man-pleads-guilty-in-Fond-du-Lac-Reservation-funeral-shooting
